mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact lets the model invent a successful operation with no authenticated caller, directly violating the FR-001/SC-005 'authentication required everywhere' invariant.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthBypass { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Success and no op.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the one-to-one binding between TaskDeletion atoms and their creating DeleteOp; the injection forces an orphan log entry with no creating operation, which is exactly the mutation/insertion the append-only contract forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some td: TaskDeletion | (no op: Operation | op.logEntry = td) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without completeness, the model can produce a successful DeleteOp that leaves no operational-log entry, which is exactly the FR-018 violation auditors must detect.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingLog { some op: Operation | op.kind = DeleteOp and op.outcome = Success and no op.logEntry }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact lets the deletion log record someone other than the actual caller, which is the canonical attribution-correctness violation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionMismatch { some op: Operation, m: Member | op.kind = DeleteOp and op.outcome = Success and some op.caller and some op.logEntry and op.logEntry.deleter = m and op.caller != m }

mutation_targets.rationale: Without this rule the model can succeed on an edit of a done task that does not reopen it, which is precisely the contract violation FR-011 forbids and the 409 task_closed response is designed to surface.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ClosedTaskBypass { some op: Operation | op.kind = EditOp and op.preStatus = Done and op.reopens = BFalse and op.changesNonStatus = BTrue and op.outcome = Success }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the title-validation invariant lets a Task exist with an invalid (empty or too-long) title; this is the validation-before-mutation contract failure for FR-005.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InvalidTitle { some t: Task | t.titleValid = BFalse }
